<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-INS-002</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Installation and upgrade</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Platform Manager, while it installs PostgreSQL</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

PostgreSQL 18 needs the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime 14.44 or newer. On a computer with an older runtime, `initdb` crashes.

## Fix it

- Use Setup 0.8.0-rc9 or later, which installs the runtime itself.
- With an older Setup, run `vc_redist.x64.exe` from the SENTIENT release page, then click **Retry**.

## Check that it worked

Setup continues past the database step.
